items.title: Hind Copper, SAIL, NMDC among 6 stocks on analysts radar amid metals slide
items.description: Silver, Copper, Gold and other metals have cracked up to 38% from recent highs. Against this background, technical analysts from Angel One and SAMCO Securities share insights on key metal stocks.

items.title: BLS Polymers zooms 8%, hits record high post Q2 nos; up 100% from IPO level
items.description: BLS Polymers, a manufacturer of multiple grades of custom-formulated polymer compounds, reported 130.63 per cent Y-o-Y growth in its PAT to ₹10.54 crore for Q2FY27, compared to ₹4.57 crore in Q2FY26.

items.title: Maruti, M&M, Hero Moto, Eicher rally up to 5%; what's driving auto stocks?
items.description: At 10:11 AM on Thursday, the Nifty Auto index was top gainer among the sectoral indices, up 2.6% at 28,111.95, compared to a 0.2 per cent rise in the Nifty 50.

items.title: Paytm, Pine Labs shares drop up to 7% amid concerns on UPI MDR delay
items.description: Reports suggest the implementation of MDR on select UPI transactions could be deferred until after assembly elections in five states during H1CY27, amid concerns over merchant opposition.

items.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Should you bid for Coal India arm? Analysts answer
items.description: Mahanadi Coalfields is India's largest single coal-producing company, supported by a sizeable reserve base, predominantly mechanised opencast operations and integrated rail and port evacuation infra

items.title: LT Foods snaps 4-day losing streak, jumps 8% on plan to acquire MK Foods
items.description: LT Foods has announced plans to acquire MK Foods Holdings Inc for an enterprise value of USD 5.8 million (around ₹54.2 crore).

items.title: Physicswallah shares gain 4% as company unveils ambitious FY30 guidance
items.description: Physicswallah announced its ambition to build an online-first education platform, targeting revenue of ₹9,000-10,000 crore by FY30.

items.title: Buy Nifty on dips as 25,000 holds; BoB among 3 stock ideas: Ajit Mishra

items.title: Record FPI buying may leave Dec flows muted; correction likely: Analysts
items.description: A comparison of November and December FPI equity flows over the past decade shows that December flows were lower than November levels in seven out of the 10 years between 2016 and 2025.

items.title: DIIs sell ₹55K cr in Nov amid record FII inflows: Tactical or behavioural?
items.description: Amid the sustained inflows in the mutual funds, it's unlikely that DIIs will remain net sellers for long, believe analysts.

items.title: FPIs pour record ₹84K cr in 1st half of Nov; financials, auto rake in most
items.description: Financial services attract more than half of foreign inflows, while telecom, auto and IT stocks also draw significant overseas investment

items.title: New launches to keep Oberoi Realty's sales momentum elevated in FY27

items.title: Sebi mulls Capacity Building Network to strengthen independent directors
items.description: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey says the proposed network will promote peer learning, strengthen boardroom oversight and help independent directors navigate emerging technology risks.

items.title: SAMIL rises 4% on volume surge, Korea unit liquidation; Geojit keeps 'Buy'

items.title: Tata Tech jumps over 9% as FY30 roadmap targets $1.3 billion revenue

items.title: Nifty IT tanks for 3rd day, down 6.5% in Nov so far: What's behind fall?

items.title: ITC share price tops ₹300-mark after 6-month gap; jumps 19% from Oct low

items.title: Tiger Global Management backed Razorpay prepares to file for IPO next week

items.title: AC makers shine as copper extends fall; Voltas, Blue Star rally up to 8%

items.title: PB Fintech shares slide over 6% after co-founder Alok Bansal steps down
